title: merge_from_file/merge_from_content recompute dummy_hash after merge
description: After a credential_file merge, dummy_hash is recomputed from the merged entry set (not the original). This ensures the dummy hash tracks the highest-cost factor in the combined store, not just the inline users. A simplification that skips this recompute would silently break the timing-safe guarantee when the file entries have a different cost. The explicit recompute in both merge methods is correct and should not be 'optimized' away.
